mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate over the preceding three months signals a tightening monetary policy stance, raising discount rates and reducing present value of future corporate cash flows, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises by > 0.75% q/q over last 3 months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered episodes, or the median return is not statistically different from zero at 5% significance.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in real personal consumption expenditures (proxied by GDPC1) exceeding 2% indicates weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered episodes, or the average return is not significantly negative at 5% significance.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 6.5% for two consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which reduces consumer spending and corporate margins, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative during triggered periods at 5% significance.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent monthly decline in the industrial production index (INDPRO) for three consecutive months signals contraction in manufacturing activity, which reduces earnings for industrial firms and drags down S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of triggered episodes, or the median return is not significantly below zero at 5% significance.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both the federal funds rate and core CPI inflation above 3% in the same month signals a dual monetary and inflationary shock, which increases real discount rates and erodes real corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 3% AND CPIAUCSL > 103 in the same month
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative during triggered months at 5% significance.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid increase in housing starts (HOUST) above the previous 12-month average by more than 10% in a single month signals a housing market recovery, which boosts construction-related equities and supports broader market returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during triggered months at 5% significance.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent rise in both payroll employment (PAYEMS) and unemployment rate (UNRATE) in the same month indicates a mixed labor market signal, often preceding a slowdown, and predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases AND UNRATE increases in the same month
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative during triggered months at 5% significance.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent monthly decline in real personal savings (RSAFS) below its 12-month moving average for four consecutive months signals reduced household buffer and increased consumption financing needs, which raises default risk and predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS < 12-month moving average for 4 consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative during triggered periods at 5% significance.
